routes_missing_title.context: Title of the full screen shown when required map files are missing (rare since the map downloads itself)

routes_missing_found.context: Status at the end of a file row (green): the file is on the phone

routes_missing_missing.context: Status at the end of a file row (red): the file is missing

routes_missing_adb.context: Line above the adb command box (for developers copying data with a computer)

routes_missing_copy_command.context: Content description (accessibility) of the copy button next to the adb command

routes_missing_target.context: Small grey text; %1$s = the data folder path on the phone (after a line break)

routes_missing_check_again.context: Main button: look for the files again

routes_missing_continue.context: Second button: open the app anyway

routes_data_import.context: Button: pick a map package zip from the phone's storage (also in Developer tools)

routes_data_download_paths.context: Button: download the routing data (paths the planner uses), about 10 MB
routes_data_download_paths.doubt: 'Wege … laden' for routing data; the English 'paths' means the data the route planner needs

routes_activity_title.context: Title of the activity picker dialog (tap on the activity chip of the plan sheet)

routes_sac_title.context: Small label above the T1–T5 row, shown when Hike is chosen

routes_sac_button_desc.context: Content description (accessibility) of one T-level button: 'T3 · Demanding mountain hiking'. %1$d = level 1-5, %2$s = level name

routes_sac_1_name.context: SAC hiking scale T1 name (official SAC wording)

routes_sac_1_text.context: Short description of SAC T1 (official SAC description, shortened)
routes_sac_1_text.doubt: Own short form of the SAC table; 'Turnschuhe' as in the SAC table ('Turnschuhe geeignet')

routes_sac_2_name.context: SAC hiking scale T2 name (official SAC wording)

routes_sac_2_text.doubt: Own short form of the SAC table

routes_sac_3_name.context: SAC hiking scale T3 name (official SAC wording)

routes_sac_3_text.doubt: Own short form of the SAC table; long line

routes_sac_4_name.context: SAC hiking scale T4 name (official SAC wording)

routes_sac_4_text.doubt: Own short form of the SAC table; 'Grashalden' is the SAC word for steep grass

routes_sac_5_name.context: SAC hiking scale T5 name (official SAC wording)

routes_sac_5_text.doubt: Own short form of the SAC table

routes_title.context: Title of My routes (☰ → My routes): saved routes, recorded tours, imported GPX

routes_importing.context: Replaces the Import GPX button while a file is imported (with a spinner)
routes_importing.doubt: 'Wird importiert…' (passive like other progress lines) – or 'Importiere…'

routes_import_gpx.context: Button in the title bar: import a GPX file

routes_tab_planned.context: Tab: saved planned routes and imported GPX files (what syncs to the browser)

routes_tab_done.context: Tab: recorded tours (what was actually walked / ridden)

routes_empty_planned.context: Shown when the Planned tab is empty (two lines)

routes_empty_done.context: Shown when the Done tab is empty

routes_kind_planned.context: Kind of an item (line 2 of each card, icon description, backup list): a saved planned route

routes_kind_recorded.context: Kind of an item: a recorded tour

routes_kind_imported.context: Kind of an item: an imported GPX file

routes_rename_planned.context: Title of the rename dialog for a planned route

routes_rename_recorded.context: Title of the rename dialog for a recorded track

routes_rename_imported.context: Title of the rename dialog for an imported GPX. English kept as before ('gpx' in lower case – came from lowercasing 'Imported GPX'); owner may fix

routes_recording_now.context: Red line on the card of the tour that is being recorded right now

routes_end_tour_first.context: Blue box with OK at the top of My routes when a planned route is tapped during a running tour (nothing is loaded)

routes_export_all.context: ⋮ menu: all routes and tours as one ZIP of GPX files

routes_options_desc.context: Content description (accessibility) of an item's ⋮ button. %1$s = item name

routes_edit_rides.context: ⋮ menu of a recorded tour with bus / car / lift rides: edit those rides
routes_edit_rides.doubt: 'Fahrten' for bus/car/lift rides – check against the ride screens

routes_name_label.context: Label of the name field in Save / Rename dialogs

routes_unfinished_title.context: Dialog after a restart when a recording was interrupted (app or phone restarted)
routes_unfinished_title.doubt: 'Unterbrochene Tour' (what happened) instead of literal 'Unvollständige Tour'

routes_unfinished_text.context: Body: %1$s = distance ('12.5 km'), %2$s = duration ('1 h 05 min')

routes_unfinished_continue.context: Button: continue recording the interrupted tour

routes_unfinished_delete_title.context: Confirmation before deleting the interrupted tour (goes to the recycle bin)

routes_activity_from_file.context: Grey line in the track panel after a GPX import changed the activity. %1$s = activity in a sentence ('Hike T3'); German word order changed so the name stands at the end
routes_activity_from_file.doubt: Rephrased: 'Aktivität aus der Datei übernommen: Wandern T3'

routes_activity_from_tour.context: Grey line after opening a tour from My routes changed the activity. %1$s = activity in a sentence

routes_gpx_empty.context: Error when an imported file is empty or not GPX

routes_gpx_nothing.context: Error when a GPX file has no track, route or waypoint

routes_gpx_too_large.context: Error when the file is too large. %1$d = size limit in MB (60)

routes_tag_new.context: Small blue tag (one short word) after the name of a route or imported track in My routes → Planned that arrived from the paired browser (Browser sync) and was not opened yet. Gone once the user opens it.

routes_tag_changed.context: Small blue tag (one short word) after the name of a route in My routes → Planned that was changed (or renamed) in the paired browser and not opened since. Gone once the user opens it.

routes_tag_live.context: Small blue tag after the name of the plan that is on the map right now – the first row under "Recent" in My routes → Planned (or on the saved route it belongs to). Shows the plan is always kept while it is being edited.

routes_live_name.context: Name shown for the plan on the map in My routes when it was never saved and has no name yet.

routes_follow_ask_title.context: Question box in My routes when a done tour / track is tapped during a running tour (owner 2026-11-06, F1)

routes_follow_ask_text.context: Under 'Follow this tour?': %1$s = the tour's name, %2$s = its length ('3.0 km'); the recording goes on

routes_follow.context: Primary button of 'Follow this tour?': the running tour follows that tour from now (goes to the navigation)

routes_track_saved.context: Title of the slim box after 'Save tour' at the end of a tour (numbers, 'In My tours', OK) – owner 2026-11-06

routes_saved_open.context: Text button in the 'Tour saved' box: opens the tour just saved as from My tours (name the list as its title)

routes_section_recent.context: Section header in My routes → Planned: plans kept by themselves when they left the map (owner 2026-11-06); shown in capitals

routes_section_saved.context: Section header in My routes → Planned: plans the user saved (or rode); shown in capitals

routes_recent_all.context: Under the first three recent plans: shows the whole list (%1$d = how many)

routes_just_saved.context: Line on a plan just moved from Recent to Saved, until My routes closes

routes_overview_show.context: TalkBack label of the small route preview tile at the start of each row; a tap on the row opens the large overview.

routes_overview_enlarge.context: TalkBack label and click label of the small route preview tile with the ⤢ badge at the start of a row: a tap opens the large overview of the route (map fitted to it).

routes_open_row.context: TalkBack click label of a whole row in My routes; %1$s = the route's name. A tap opens the large overview (or, for the plan on the map, goes back to it).

routes_overview_plan.context: Primary button of the large route overview (map fitted to the route): open this route in Plan mode.

routes_overview_follow.context: Primary button of the route overview during a running tour: follow this route at once, the recording goes on.

routes_overview_loading.context: Small grey line while the map picture of the overview is drawn (the route shape is already shown).

routes_sac_line.context: Under the T1–T5 chips (owner 2026-11-08): the chosen level's name and description; %1$d = level, %2$s = SAC name, %3$s = SAC description
